description: Source code for the Telemetry plugin in the WPEFramework, implementing telemetry report management, privacy mode notifications, and event handling with optional RBUS and IARM bus support.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry report handling, privacy mode notifications, and event callbacks within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: setReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the report profile status based on input parameters, updating RFC parameters accordingly.

methods.name: logApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with specified name and value, sending telemetry message.

methods.name: UploadReport
methods.description: Triggers an upload of telemetry report via RBUS.

methods.name: AbortReport
methods.description: Aborts the ongoing telemetry report upload via RBUS.

methods.name: notifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies RBUS of the current privacy mode setting.

methods.name: onReportUploadStatus
methods.description: Handles the status of report upload, sending notification.
